study.title: Cassava eba consumer test, Benue State, Nigeria
study.description: Tricot consumer test of eba (stiff dough made from gari) prepared from cassava genotypes, Benue State, Nigeria. Each consumer tasted three eba samples and ranked them for colour, texture traits, taste and overall preference. RTBfoods work package 5 with IITA. Laboratory biophysical, pasting and texture measurements of the same genotypes are in genotype_data. Results are reported in Olaosebikan O, Bello A, de Sousa K, Ndjouenkeu R, Adesokan M, Alamu E, et al. (2023). Drivers of consumer acceptability of cassava gari-eba food products across cultural and environmental settings using the triadic comparison of technologies approach (tricot). Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture 104(8). https://doi.org/10.1002/jsfa.12867, and in Alamu EO, Teeken B, Ayetigbo O, Adesokan M, Kayondo I, Chijioke U, et al. (2023). Establishing the linkage between eba's instrumental and sensory descriptive profiles and their correlation with consumer preferences. Implications for cassava breeding. Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture. https://doi.org/10.1002/jsfa.12518. The source labelled this test 'Osun'; its coordinates and local checks place it in Benue State.
study.objective: consumer preference for food product quality
